title: Flat finite modules over valuation algebras are finitely presented
statement: Let $A$ be a valuation ring, meaning an integral domain whose fraction field $K$ has $a\in A$ or $a^{-1}\in A$ for every $a\in K^\times$. Let $A\to B$ be a local homomorphism which is essentially of finite type [def-weil-pbc-essentially-finite-type-algebra]. If $M$ is a finite $B$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module] that is flat as an $A$-module [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map], then $M$ is finitely presented as a $B$-module [def-sc-finitely-presented-module].
